variant.briefing:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of resources is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to deliver the supplies to [Destination]. I have ship waiting to take it to Pyro from there.

Up to you how you get the stuff. Mine it, steal it, buy it from a trader - I don’t care as long as I get what I need refined and delivered. Might be worth checking Daymar or Aberdeen to start.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows
